question: Should the blocked production deployment request TR-DEMO-002 be approved?
rationale: Production deployment exceeds the local-only demo mission authority, so TR-DEMO-002 stays rejected until a FRAGO changes the mission scope.

authority_basis.summary: Commander disposition BD-DEMO-001 of decision packet DP-DEMO-001 at the demo decision board.

review_trigger: Review at the next AAR or when a FRAGO changes the local-only constraint.
